title: Plant care app
about: A phone app that tells you when to water each plant.

branches.name: V1
branches.holds: Add your plants and get a reminder when each one needs water.

items.name: Add plants
items.why: The app knows nothing until you tell it what you grow.
items.doneWhen: A user adds a plant with a name, a photo and how often it needs water.

items.name: Watering reminders
items.why: The reason people get the app: no more dry plants.
items.doneWhen: The phone pings on the day a plant needs water.

items.name: Release V1
items.why: The first version is out.
items.doneWhen: Anyone can get the app from the app stores and add a plant.

branches.name: V2
branches.holds: Share your plants with your home, and name a plant from a photo.

items.name: User survey
items.why: Ask V1 users what they miss most.
items.doneWhen: 50 users answered, and their top three asks are listed.

items.name: Sharing design
items.why: The top ask in the survey: people look after plants together.
items.doneWhen: The screens to invite someone and share the watering are drawn and agreed.

items.name: Sharing server
items.why: Two phones must see the same plants.
items.doneWhen: A plant watered on one phone shows as watered on the other within 5 seconds.

items.name: Phone invite
items.why: Most people invite someone from their phone.
items.doneWhen: A user invites a housemate, who sees the plants after one tap.

items.name: Web invite
items.why: Some people plan their plants on a computer.
items.doneWhen: The same invite works on the website.

items.name: Sharing tests
items.why: Sharing breaks in quiet ways, like two people watering the same plant.
items.doneWhen: The tests for invites and shared watering run on each change and pass.

split.name: Photo ID
split.holds: Take a photo of a plant, and the app says what it is.

items.name: Own plant photos
items.why: A way out if the plant data deal falls through.
items.doneWhen: We have our own photos of the 200 most common house plants.

items.name: Supplier signs
items.why: The plant photo supplier must sign the license before we can.
items.doneWhen: The supplier has signed the license.

items.name: Plant data deal
items.why: Photo ID learns from the supplier's plant photos.
items.doneWhen: The license is signed by both sides.

items.name: Photo ID
items.why: The second ask in the survey: what is this plant?

items.name: Dark mode
items.why: Dropped: few users asked for it in the survey.

items.name: Invite testers
items.why: Real homes find what we miss.

items.name: Fix top bugs
items.why: Testers hit bugs we never saw.

items.name: Release V2
items.why: Sharing and Photo ID reach every user before the holidays.
items.doneWhen: V2 is in the app stores.

branches.name: V3
branches.holds: Care past watering: tips for each plant, and a watch app to try.

items.name: User survey
items.why: Ask V2 users which of these they want.

items.name: Care tips
items.why: Light, food and new pots, for each kind of plant.

items.name: Plant shop
items.why: Sell pots and plant food in the app, with a garden store.

items.name: Watch app
items.why: A try. It may stay a side app.
